items.text: Edward Jones states that it primarily derives revenues from fees for providing investment advisory and other account services to clients, fees for assets held by clients, and commissions for distributing mutual fund shares and insurance products and for securities transactions.
items.quote: primarily derives revenues from fees for providing investment advisory and other account services to its clients, fees for assets held by clients and commissions for the distribution of mutual fund shares and insurance products and the purchase or sale of securities

items.text: Within fee revenue, Edward Jones's asset-based fees include advisory program fees based on the average daily market value of client assets in the program and contractual rates, and these fees are affected by changes in market values and by client dollars invested in and divested from the accounts.
items.quote: fee revenue is composed of asset-based fees and account and activity fees. Asset-based fees include advisory program fees which are based on the average daily market value of client assets in the program, as well as contractual rates.

items.text: Edward Jones earns revenue on clients' assets through service fees and revenue sharing received under agreements with certain mutual fund and insurance companies.
items.quote: The Partnership earns revenue on clients’ assets through service fees and revenue sharing received under agreements with certain mutual fund and insurance companies.

items.text: For mutual funds, Edward Jones's service fees are generally based on the average daily market value of client assets held in a company's mutual fund or insurance product, and service fee revenue is recognized monthly once the transaction price is known and the services have been performed.
items.quote: Service fees are generally based on the average daily market value of client assets held in a company's mutual fund or insurance product. ... service fee revenue is recognized monthly at the time the market constraints have been removed, the transaction price is known and the services have been performed.

items.text: Edward Jones's other asset-based fee revenue consists of revenue sharing, fund adviser fees, cash solutions and Trust Co. fees.
items.quote: Other asset-based fee revenue consists of revenue sharing, fund adviser fees, cash solutions and Trust Co. fees.

items.text: Edward Jones earns cash solutions revenue from the Edward Jones Insured Bank Deposit Program, an interest-bearing cash management solution for clients.
items.quote: Cash solutions revenue is earned from the Edward Jones Insured Bank Deposit Program ("IBD Program"), which is an interest-bearing cash management solution for clients

items.text: Edward Jones also earns certain asset-based fees and per-account fees from the Edward Jones Money Market Fund, some or all of which may be voluntarily waived, while its subsidiary Olive Street earns investment management fees as the fund's investment adviser.
items.quote: Olive Street is the investment adviser of the Money Market Fund and earns investment management fees as the investment adviser to the Money Market Fund. Edward Jones also earns certain asset-based fees and per-account fees from the Money Market Fund, some or all of which may be voluntarily waived.

items.text: In addition to advisory programs, Edward Jones earns asset-based fees from trust services and investment management services offered through Edward Jones Trust Company, a wholly-owned subsidiary.
items.quote: the Partnership earns asset-based fees from the trust services and investment management services offered to its clients through Edward Jones Trust Company (“Trust Co.”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of JFC.
